text: Machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence that allows computers to learn from data. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model. A model is like a set of rules that helps the computer recognize patterns. After training, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it can predict whether an email is spam or not. We measure how good the model is by checking its accuracy, which means how often its predictions are correct. The more training data a model receives, the better its predictions usually become.
